summary: Luxoflux and Activision's open-world police action series, ending after two released games before the canceled True Crime: Hong Kong project was reborn as Sleeping Dogs.

entries.title: True Crime: Streets of LA

emulation.emulator: Native Windows, Dolphin, PCSX2, or xemu
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; emulate consoles only for original-platform comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC version with PC-specific additions

primary.why: Streets of LA released on GameCube, PlayStation 2, Xbox, Windows, Mobile, and Mac OS X. The Windows version adds online multiplayer modes, enhanced graphics, additional songs, PC-optimized controls, and PC-exclusive character skins, making it the most complete high-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with modern compatibility fixes if needed; sample the mobile adaptation only as preservation material.

secondary.what_to_play: Document or sample the mobile adaptation separately from the PC main run if a legal preserved copy is available.
secondary.why: The mobile release is a distinct adaptation rather than the definitive full game.

all_releases.fidelity: PC port with enhanced graphics, online multiplayer, extra songs, PC-optimized controls, and PC-exclusive character skins.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete route.
skip: computer route but no sourced content advantage over Windows.
skip: original route but lacks the sourced PC additions.
skip: original route but lacks the sourced PC additions.
skip: original route but lacks the sourced PC additions.
secondary: distinct mobile adaptation for preservation, not the main route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is both the main fidelity and expanded-feature route, while the mobile adaptation is separate preservation material.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; PC may need compatibility fixes.
